# UX Checklist: Snack Rich Formatting (Rendering)

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of the *rendering and display requirements* for snack rich formatting — not the implementation. This is a "unit test for the requirements" for how formatted snack text must appear across surfaces (US2, US5, FR-010–FR-014, FR-023).
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) — sections §User Story 2, §User Story 5, §Requirements (Rendering, History), §Edge Cases, §Success Criteria

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.checklist`. Items test whether the requirements are well-written, complete, and verifiable — they are not runtime test cases.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the rendered output semantics specified for each whitelisted construct (bold, bullet list, paragraph)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK002 Is it explicitly required that literal markers (`**`, leading `-`/`*`/`•`) never appear? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011, §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are all three formatted fields (`concept`, `metaphor`, `whyItMatters`) specified as rich, and is `related` specified as plain? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK004 Are the three display surfaces (snack card, results recap, history view) all named in the rendering requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for fields that contain no markup? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK006 Is the desired presentation of a long field without bullets specified? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "actual bold text" quantified with a concrete rendering outcome rather than a visual adjective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Is "bullet list (list items)" defined precisely enough to be objectively verified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is "multiple short paragraphs rather than a single long paragraph" defined with a measurable criterion (paragraph boundary rule)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Is "clean plain text with no formatting artifacts" defined (no empty paragraphs, empty lists, or stray markers)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK011 Is the bold marker convention (`**...**`) and its recognition rule unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, contracts/snack-text-format.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Do the rendering requirements agree across the snack card, recap, and history view with no surface-specific exceptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK013 Is the bullet-marker tolerance (`-`, `*`, `•`) consistent between the prompt requirement and the rendering requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-011, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Do the no-artifact requirements for empty/plain fields align with the paragraph model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Does the "no redesign of the snack card layout" non-goal conflict with any typography requirement? [Consistency, Spec §Non-Goals, plan.md §Design]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can "0 literal `**` sequences are visible" be objectively measured across all surfaces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 Can "100% of bullet lines render as list items" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK018 Is "0 long fields render as one unbroken paragraph" stated in a measurable way? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK019 Is consistency of rendering across surfaces expressed as a verifiable criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, §FR-013]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for an unclosed/malformed bold marker without swallowing the rest of the field? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for stray asterisks that are not formatting (e.g. `5 * 3 = 15`)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Is mixed content (paragraph → list → paragraph) required to render in order without merging/reordering? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are bullet lines with varying markers and inconsistent spacing addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for Unicode, emoji, and RTL text combined with formatting? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Is bold adjacent to punctuation or spanning a line break addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for previously stored (pre-feature) snacks rendering without artifacts, including in history? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §Non-Goals]

## Accessibility & Non-Functional

- [x] CHK027 Are accessibility expectations for the rendered rich text (semantic list/emphasis, screen-reader text) specified or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap] — **Resolved**: Spec §Non-Goals now explicitly excludes new accessibility scope (native semantic elements; existing app conventions apply).
- [x] CHK028 Is the typography/vertical-rhythm requirement for rendered paragraphs and lists defined relative to existing design tokens? [Completeness, Gap, plan.md §Design]
- [x] CHK029 Is the performance expectation for render-time parsing stated as acceptable or bounded? [Coverage, Gap, plan.md §Performance Goals]

## Dependencies & Ambiguities

- [x] CHK030 Is the shared-renderer requirement (one component reused on all surfaces) documented as the mechanism guaranteeing consistency? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, research.md R4]
- [x] CHK031 Is the assumption that formatting applies only to `concept`/`metaphor`/`whyItMatters` validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK032 Is it specified how `related` markup-like characters must be treated (plain labels, never interpreted)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
